gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Commanding from the first word, Paprika spreads its letters wide and lets the lowercase fill the line like capitals. Noto Sans Marchen follows with small letters that stand almost capital-sized, their curves ending in clear daylight.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numera: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads contemporary and businesslike, with tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c at any size. Paprika is the loud one with hollow, breathing counters; the sans-serif just gets on with it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Paprika scatters its letters at a distance and fills the line with lowercase that behaves like capitals, all expressive swagger. Its strength is contrast against Noto Sans Medefaidrin, whose lowercase rises high.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Loose, loud and wide-set, Paprika fills the line with lowercase that acts like capitals. Yet Noto Sans Meetei Mayek sits beside it quietly, a plain sans whose rounds gap like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Wide-spaced and bold in attitude, Paprika lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui then takes over with daylight through every curve, its lowercase standing tall against the capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Approachable is not what Paprika does, but it grabs attention with letters scattered at a distance and lowercase that fills the line. Noto Sans Meroitic gives it a friendly counterpart, with c openings you can see through.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-modi: Paprika sets its letters far apart and its counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Noto Sans Modi brings the strongest quality here: daylight in every curve and a low contrast between capital and body height.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so they never bump. Beside Paprika's expressive, wide-scattered display forms, its sturdy tall lowercase and open curves make the strongest quality of this pair a clear division of labor.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-multani: Lowercase that fills the line like capitals, spread at a distance, is Paprika's whole personality, and it is a loud one. Noto Sans Multani stays a plain sans, with a lofty x-height and open-gapped e.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Commanding and expressive, Paprika scatters its letters wide and lets its counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open. But Noto Sans Myanmar forms a thick, heavy-looking strip of text, and its broad c keeps a long page welcoming.
